item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 20
item.description:
8 development commits

World & Structures

  • Reduced furnace collider triangle count to stay under the convex mesh limit, preventing physics errors and potential server crashes when placing or interacting with furnaces.

Networking & Performance

  • Reduced the number of network groups for rooms, improving network performance and reducing lag or disconnects in multiplayer bases.
